reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。The paper uses policy-gradient fine-tuning to improve discrete diffusion generation. Experiments are training/alignment focused and do not establish fewer inference steps or lower inference cost; only a weak diffusion-family relation remains.
title: Fine-Tuning Discrete Diffusion Models with Policy Gradient Methods
